content: Regarding the task of data anonymisation in particular, anonymisation systems may follow different approaches and pursue different objectives (Cormode and Srivastava, 2009). The first objective of these systems is to detect and classify the sensitive information contained in the documents to be anonymised. In order to achieve that, they use rule-based approaches, Machine Learning (ML) approaches, or a combination of both.
